sentences.text: The solution adds domains to derivors.
A generalized H E P derivor between H E P signatures sends every sort to a sort together with a domain, a set of existence equations in one variable, and every operation symbol to a term.
The transformed algebra keeps, as cells, the elements that satisfy the domains.
An operation is defined at some cells when three conditions hold:
its domain conditions hold in the transformed algebra itself, its term is defined, and the value is again a cell.
The domains solve the first obstacle, and the first condition solves the second.
Since the hierarchy is well-founded, this is a valid definition by recursion.
